searchText: lets maybe take this into a thread i guess this is not about lighthouse-ethrex-1? no, it is devnet-5 but this is just a random node i spun up ``` participants: - el_type: ethrex el_image: ethpandaops/ethrex:glamsterdam-devnet-5 cl_type: lighthouse cl_image: ethpandaops/lighthouse:glamsterdam-devnet-5 cl_extra_params: ["--ignore-ws-check"] validator_count: 0 network_params: network: glamsterdam-devnet-5 checkpoint_sync_enabled: true checkpoint_sync_url: https://checkpoint-sync.glamsterdam-devnet-5.ethpandaops.io additional_services: - dora global_log_level: debug port_publisher: additional_services: enabled: true ``` can you check by any chance if its --syncmode=full or its trying to snap sync? i merged snap/2 to it and maybe it causes issues https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package/blob/main/src/el/ethrex/ethrex_launcher.star#L164 ah this doesnt seem to be an ethrex issue. i think theres a peer(s) somewhere serving bad by range responses for some epochs, which causes us to ban peers. we just happened to hit that a few times running ethrex and not nethermind. was able to sync to head with ethrex now good to know, if anything seems wrong with ethrex lmk! might have been the fucked up prysm nodes? since the wipe i havent seen any peers serving us bad data lodestar-ethrex-1 is now also magically synced

excerpts.author: 0xunclebill
excerpts.content:
no, it is devnet-5 but this is just a random node i spun up 

```
participants:
  - el_type: ethrex
    el_image: ethpandaops/ethrex:glamsterdam-devnet-5
    cl_type: lighthouse
    cl_image: ethpandaops/lighthouse:glamsterdam-devnet-5
    cl_extra_params: ["--ignore-ws-check"]
    validator_count: 0

network_params:
  network: glamsterdam-devnet-5

checkpoint_sync_enabled: true
checkpoint_sync_url: https://checkpoint-sync.glamsterdam-devnet-5.ethpandaops.io

additional_services:
  - dora

global_log_level: debug

port_publisher:
  additional_services:
    enabled: true
```
